mapper.sql: c.id, c.class_period, c.head_teacher_id, coalesce(nullif(u.real_name, ''), nullif(u.nickname, ''), u.username) as head_teacher_name, c.campus_id, ca.campus_location as campus_name, c.course_id, cr.course_name, c.created_at, c.updated_at
mapper.select:
select from sys_class c inner join sys_user u on u.id = c.head_teacher_id inner join sys_campus ca on ca.id = c.campus_id inner join sys_course cr on cr.id = c.course_id
and (c.class_period like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.username like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.real_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ca.campus_location like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cr.course_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and c.head_teacher_id = #{headTeacherId} and c.campus_id = #{campusId} and c.course_id = #{courseId}
order by c.id desc
select from sys_class c inner join sys_user u on u.id = c.head_teacher_id inner join sys_campus ca on ca.id = c.campus_id inner join sys_course cr on cr.id = c.course_id where c.id = #{id}
select id, class_period, head_teacher_id, campus_id, course_id, created_at, updated_at from sys_class where id = #{id}
select count(*) from sys_class where class_period = #{classPeriod} and id != #{excludeId}

select count(distinct u.id) from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.id inner join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id where u.id = #{userId} and u.status = 'ACTIVE' and r.role_code = 'HEAD_TEACHER' and r.status = 'ACTIVE'
select count(*) from sys_campus where id = #{campusId}
select count(*) from sys_course where id = #{courseId}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_class(class_period, head_teacher_id, campus_id, course_id, created_at, updated_at) values(#{classPeriod}, #{headTeacherId}, #{campusId}, #{courseId}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update sys_class set class_period = #{classPeriod}, head_teacher_id = #{headTeacherId}, campus_id = #{campusId}, course_id = #{courseId}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
